name: maritime-gateway
title: UNE Maritime Eco-Fuel, FuelEU & EU ETS Deterministic Gateway
description: Deterministic EU Maritime Decarbonization Suite: FuelEU Maritime (Regulation EU 2023/1805) Annex IV statutory penalties, Annex I multi-leg voyage GHG intensity, Annex II fuel factor lookup, Article 20 banking/borrowing solver, Article 21 fleet pool optimizer, and EU ETS Maritime (Directive EU 2023/959) multi-year surrender engine.

tools.name: lookup_fuel_wtw_emission_factor
tools.description: Returns deterministic statutory Well-to-Wake (WtW), Well-to-Tank (WtT), Tank-to-Wake (TtW), and Lower Calorific Value (LCV) metrics from FuelEU Maritime Annex II default tables.

fuel_type.description: Standard fuel code according to Regulation (EU) 2023/1805 Annex II.

tools.name: calculate_voyage_ghg_intensity
tools.description: Calculates certified aggregated Well-to-Wake GHG intensity (gCO2eq/MJ), energy consumption (MJ), and net compliance balance (tCO2eq) for multi-leg maritime voyages under FuelEU Annex I, with Article 2 scope validation.

voyage_legs.description: List of voyage legs with mandatory departure and arrival UN/LOCODEs, scope, and fuel consumptions.

tools.name: calculate_fueleu_banking_borrowing
tools.description: Deterministic solver for FuelEU Maritime Article 20 banking of surplus and borrowing of deficit balance. Computes statutory borrowing ceilings (2% cap), mandatory 1.1x penalty factor, multi-year consecutive limit, and optimal arbitrage vs Article 21 pooling.

compliance_balance_tco2eq.description: Signed CB in tCO2eq (negative = deficit, positive = surplus)

total_energy_consumed_tj.description: Total annual energy consumed in Terajoules (TJ)

market_pooling_price_eur_per_t.description: Current OTC price to buy surplus in an Art. 21 pool (EUR/t)

tools.name: optimize_fueleu_pool_allocation
tools.description: Deterministic solver for FuelEU Maritime Article 21 compliance pool optimization. Given a set of vessels with individual compliance balances and market prices for compliance surplus, returns optimal pool composition, verified statutory savings under Annex IV, and governance flags. Designed for Chinese and European shipowners operating on China-Europe routes.

ships.description: Participating vessels with compliance balances, WTW intensity, and asking prices.

api_key.description: Optional UNE API key for certified transfer manifests.

tools.name: calculate_fueleu_maritime_penalty
tools.description: Calculates FuelEU Maritime compliance balance, GHG intensity deficit, and statutory cash penalties under the Annex IV formula: (deficit_gCO2eq / (actual_intensity * 41000)) * 2400 EUR. The statutory reference rate is EUR 2,400 per metric tonne of VLSFO-equivalent.

tools.name: calculate_maritime_ets_surrender
tools.description: Calculates EU ETS Maritime allowance (EUA) surrender obligations under Directive (EU) 2023/959 with multi-year statutory phase-in rates (40% in 2024, 70% in 2025, 100% in 2026+).

tools.name: provision_free_api_key
tools.description: Provisions a free sandbox API key (50 credits) for agents to unlock certified statutory compliance dossiers, BIMCO clause liability audits, and unredacted EU regulations.

use_case.description: Intended maritime freight or ETS/FuelEU auditing workflow
